word.definition: Dubious describes a person who lacks a definite opinion or is doubtful about something; this sense of the word is usually used with about .

sports_fact.text: Ozzie Smith won 13 consecutive Gold Gloves at shortstop and did a backflip on Opening Day. The Wizard earned the nickname.

quote.text: A free man thinks of death least of all things; and his wisdom is a meditation not of death but of life.

history.text: A national speed limit is imposed on the Autobahn in Germany because of the 1973 oil crisis. The speed limit lasts only four months.
